items.name: No Eviction Tombstone / Poison Value
items.anti_pattern: LRU eviction does not poison or tombstone entity ID slots. Stale entity IDs may silently resolve to recycled slots.
items.counter_case: TypeScript Map.get() returns undefined for missing keys; silent reuse only occurs if entity IDs are explicitly recycled.
